slides.notes: That’s why we began our Responsible AI journey back in 2017. We believe that the development and deployment of AI must be guided by the creation of an ethical framework. In 2018, we set out our view that there are six core principles that should guide the work around AI. But it’s not enough to define these principles – we need to operationalize them at scale as well. We’re focused on four key areas to help put these principles into action: First, you need governance. Second, you need the rules to standardize AI requirements. Third, you need training and best practices. And fourth, you need the tools for implementation. We’ll talk more about some of this tooling later on, but for now let’s ask the question: How can you get started? 9
